newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's future leader hails Deng as a great leader.
newsitem.headline: HK's future leader hails Deng as a great leader.

text.p: Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa expressed his sorrow on Thursday at the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, who he praised as a "great leader".
"China last night lost a great leader," Tung, anointed by Beijing in December as Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader, told a news conference in the Chinese capital.
Tung, a former shipping tycoon, said Deng's reforms had laid a stable foundation which would enable China to grow stronger and richer and Hong Kong to prosper in tandem.

Tung, appointed a member of Deng's 459-strong funeral committee led by President Jiang Zemin, was visiting Beijing to discuss his post-colonial civil service appointees with the Chinese leadership. He returns later on Thursday.
Tung will step into British Governor Chris Patten's shoes when Hong Kong, a British colony for more than 150 years, reverts to China at midnight on June 30.
